# Grainulation

> Open tools for work with AI. Grainulation builds Grainulator.

Grainulation is the organization. Grainulator is the flagship product: a portable workflow for model-assisted research, evidence, verification, and continuation. The consolidation brings the earlier tools into internal modules within one product instead of asking users to choose among separate tool installs.

## Product

- [Grainulator](https://grainulator.app/): product overview and evidence-check example.
- [Research playground](https://grainulator.app/playground): configure a provider, model, research passes, claims ledger, and evidence gate; inspect and export a session.
- [Source](https://github.com/grainulation/grainulator): product source and documentation.
- [Organization](https://github.com/grainulation): project history and contributions.

## Principles and boundaries

- Keep model and host interfaces explicit. Provider or adapter support determines compatibility.
- Keep claims, evidence, and uncertainty visible. A source link or model agreement does not establish independent verification.
- Preserve context, configuration, and completed work in portable sessions.
- Treat independent checks as the standard for task completion.
- Evaluate improvements with controlled tasks and independent criteria. Do not infer model-quality gains from a product demonstration.

The earlier repositories retain their history while consolidation proceeds. This document describes the new product direction; release availability and installation instructions belong in the product documentation.
